label: scale_db_fetch_psql_50k_100k
how: psql inside the local-rag-postgres container (no network hop), \timing on, run by hand after scale_db_37_1_in_container crashed at 50k. Tables and data from that run: bench_fresh_chunks, 3 chunks per document, HNSW index dropped, PostgreSQL 16.14, container memory limit 1 GiB, shared_buffers 128MB, work_mem 4MB.

queries.first_chunk_only: SELECT ... FROM bench_fresh_chunks WHERE dataset_id = X AND chunk_index = 0 (the query list_document_versions now uses)
queries.distinct_all_columns: SELECT DISTINCT document_id, source, status, document_version, effective_from, supersedes_source, tenant_id FROM bench_fresh_chunks WHERE dataset_id = X (the previous query)

server_crashes: 2026-11-22 18:26:22 UTC, first scale run, during the database part (exact query not logged)
2026-11-22 19:05:16 UTC, scale_db_37_1_in_container, inside the version-fetch-variants loop at 50k, after list_document_versions (chunk_index = 0) had completed
